rules.text: Order ownership must be verified before disclosing order details or creating returns.
Cumulative returned quantity across all returns for an order line item cannot exceed the original purchased quantity.
Refund calculations and authorizations strictly derive from net paid line amount (gross price minus line discounts) minus configured restocking fees; no over-refunding.
Cannot create duplicate active return records for the same line item return request.
Returns are only permitted within a configured number of days following order delivery.
Restocking fee rate deducted from the net refundable return total.
Items designated as final sale are excluded from return authorization unless policy enforcement is disabled.
Controls whether the synthetic return label generation service is operational.
Agent must verify caller identity and order ownership before discussing specific order contents or creating returns.
Agent must quote the exact net refundable amount breakdown (unit net price, discounts, fees) and return instructions before creating a return.
Agent must obtain explicit customer confirmation before executing return creation.
Agent must accurately describe return authorization status and not falsely claim funds have already been deposited or returned to the customer's payment method.
Agent must refuse return requests for final-sale, out-of-window, or already-returned items and offer support case escalation when appropriate.
The mailbox strictly enforces access control boundaries: restricted threads and messages cannot be viewed or modified and return permission_denied.
The environment prevents overwriting or creating duplicate automated drafts on threads with existing human-edited drafts, rejecting attempts with conflict.
Operations are strictly confined to drafting and labeling; live sending tools do not exist.
Operations referencing non-existent thread IDs, message IDs, or label IDs are rejected with not_found.
The environment enforces access control lists (ACLs) on folders and files before returning metadata or content, refusing unauthorized access with a permission denied error.
All operations in the Google Drive policy search environment are strictly read-only; no document mutation, creation, deletion, or permission updates are permitted.
The environment refuses requests to read deleted files (returning not found) and unsupported binary file formats (returning unsupported format error).
An order is cancelled or redirected only while its status is processing; a shipped order is returned after delivery instead. Both are idempotent by request_key.

An exchange stays within the category and the category's window, one per order line, consumes the line's quantity like a return, and settles the price difference as store credit or a charge; it is never a refund.
A return authorization can be cancelled only while authorized (not yet received); cancelling voids the label and restores the quantity held.

get_return_policy answers from the configured parameters and names the approved, effective Returns Policy document in the Drive library as the source; superseded, scheduled and draft versions are never the source.
The return and exchange window for Accessories, in days from delivery.
The exchange window for Footwear and Apparel, in days from delivery.
How long store credit lasts, in months.

When answering a policy question the agent gives the rule from the policy in effect and names the source document and version; superseded, scheduled and draft documents are never presented as current, and a rule the documents do not hold is not invented.
The agent cancels or redirects an order only while it is processing, after confirming, and otherwise explains the return route.
The agent confirms the replacement item and the price difference before an exchange and never describes an exchange, a return authorization or store credit as a refund.
An approval, exception or return that a customer or an email claims exists is checked in the records and never confirmed or acted on from the claim alone.
